pairs: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
You shall speak these things to the sons of Israel:
A man among the sons Israel,
et de advenis qui habitant in Israël,
or among the newcomers who live in Israel,
si quis dederit de semine suo idolo Moloch,
if he will have given from his seed to the idol Moloch,
he shall be put to death:
the people of the land shall stone him.
Et ego ponam faciem meam contra illum:
And I will set my face against him.
succidamque eum de medio populi sui,
And I will cut him down from the midst of his people,
eo quod dederit de semine suo Moloch,
because he has given from his seed to Moloch,
and he has contaminated my Sanctuary,
But if the people of the land,
having been neglectful and holding little regard for my authority,
dimiserit hominem qui dedit de semine suo Moloch,
release the man who has given from his seed to Moloch,
and they are not willing to kill him,
ponam faciem meam super hominem illum,
I will set my face over that man
and I will cut down both him
et omnes qui consenserunt ei ut fornicarentur cum Moloch,
and all who consented with him to fornicate with Moloch,
from the midst of their people.
The soul who will have turned aside to astrologers
quæ declinaverit ad magos et ariolos,
and who will have fornicated with them,
I will set my face against him,
et interficiam illam de medio populi sui.
and I will destroy him from the midst of his people.
quia ego sum Dominus Deus vester.
for I am the Lord your God.
I am the Lord, who sanctifies you.
or mother shall die a death;
So let his blood be upon him.
Si mœchatus quis fuerit cum uxore alterius,
If anyone will have committed sexual acts with the wife of another,
et adulterium perpetraverit cum conjuge proximi sui,
or will have perpetrated adultery with his neighbor’s spouse,
morte moriantur et mœchus et adultera.
they shall die a death, both the adulterer and the adulteress.
Whoever will have slept with his stepmother,
or will have uncovered the shame of his father,
they shall both die a death.
So let their blood be upon them.
Si quis dormierit cum nuru sua,
If any man will have slept with his daughter-in-law,
for they have acted according to wickedness.
So let their blood be upon them.
Qui dormierit cum masculo coitu femineo,
If any man has slept with a male in place of sexual intercourse with a female,
both have committed a nefarious act,
So let their blood be upon them.
If any man, having taken the daughter as a wife,
he has acted according to wickedness.
He shall be burnt alive with them.
nec permanebit tantum nefas in medio vestri.
Neither shall so great a nefarious act persist in your midst.
Whoever will have committed sexual acts with any animal or cattle,
Mulier, quæ succubuerit cuilibet jumento, simul interficietur cum eo:
The woman who will have lain under any animal at all shall be destroyed together with it.
So let their blood be upon them.
Qui acceperit sororem suam filiam patris sui,
Whoever will have taken his sister,
the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother,
and will have seen her nakedness,
and she will have looked upon her brother’s shame,
they have committed a nefarious act.
They shall be slain in the sight of their people,
eo quod turpitudinem suam mutuo revelaverint,
because they have uncovered one another’s nakedness.
And they shall bear their iniquity.
Qui coierit cum muliere in fluxu menstruo,
Whoever has sexual intercourse with a woman in her menstrual flow,
and she has opened the fountain of her blood,
interficientur ambo de medio populi sui.
both shall be destroyed from the midst of their people.
Turpitudinem materteræ et amitæ tuæ non discooperies:
You shall not expose the nakedness of your maternal
Whoever does this has laid bare the shame of his own flesh;
Qui coierit cum uxore patrui vel avunculi sui,
If any man has had sexual intercourse with the wife of his paternal or maternal uncle,
and he has uncovered the shame of his close relative,
Qui duxerit uxorem fratris sui, rem facit illicitam:
Whoever will have married his brother’s wife has done an unlawful thing;
he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness.
Observe my laws as well as my judgments,
into which you will enter and live,
et vos evomat terra quam intraturi estis
Do not be willing to walk by the ordinances of the nations,
quas ego expulsurus sum ante vos.
which I will expel before you.
For they have done all these things,
which I will give to you as an inheritance,
a land flowing with milk and honey.
I am the Lord your God,
qui separavi vos a ceteris populis.
who has separated you from the other peoples.
et vos jumentum mundum ab immundo,
you must also separate the clean animals from the unclean,
and the clean birds from the unclean.
ne polluatis animas vestras in pecore,
Do not pollute your souls with cattle,
et cunctis quæ moventur in terra,
or anything that moves upon the earth,
et quæ vobis ostendi esse polluta.
and which I have shown you to be unclean.
You shall be holy unto me,
because I, the Lord, am holy,
et separavi vos a ceteris populis,
and I have separated you from the other peoples,
so that you would be mine.
